title: Pāsāno
text: 1. Ekaṃ samayam Bhagavā Rājagahe viharati Gijjhakūṭapabbate || || 2. Tena kho pana samayena Bhagavā rattandhakāratimisāyam ajjhokāse nisinno hoti devo ca ekam ekam phusāyati || || 3. Atha kho Māro pāpimā Bhagavato bhayaṃ chambhitattaṃ lomahaṃsam uppādetu-kāmo yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || Upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavato avidūre mahante mahante pāsāṇe padālesi || || 4. Atha kho Bhagavā Māro ayam pāpimā iti viditvā Māram pāpimantaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi || || Sa ce pi kevalaṃ sabbam || Gijjhakūṭam calessasi || n-eva sammā vimuttānaṃ || buddhānam atthi iñjitan ti || || 5. Atha kho Māro pāpimā jānāti maṃ Bhagavā jānāti maṃ Sugato ti dukkhī dummano tatth-ev-antaradhāyīti || ||
